summary: Hallador Energy Company filed an 8-K reporting a Third Amendment to its Credit Agreement with Texas Capital Bank as administrative agent and the lenders. The amendment modifies the EBITDA definition to permit adding back up to $10 million in payments received from power purchase agreement exclusivity agreements for the fiscal quarter ended June 30, 2026. This is a routine credit agreement amendment creating a direct financial obligation, not a special situation. No strategic transactions, board actions, or unusual events are involved. What to watch: any future material changes to credit terms or liquidity.
